messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered for service `inference-queue` - PD#INC-9021. Alert: queue length > 22,000 and p50 token latency > 2.0s. Region: eu-central-1.

maya: acking the page. jumping in - checking autoscaler and node pool.

aj: oncall here, what's HPA status? any recent deploys?

maya: no deploys in last 3h. HPA desired pods=150, current pods=22, scaling attempts failing - pods stuck in Init:MountVolume. cloud shows EFS throttling and mount target ENOSPC errors.

sam: I see error in kubelet logs on new nodes: `failed to mount nfs: transport endpoint is not connected` and EFS bursting rejects. New nodes stuck NotReady.

leah: FYI, a scheduled long-seq benchmark ran 11:45 UTC and we had a warmup flood - lots of cold KV loads. Might have triggered EFS burst limit.

maya: runbook fallback: 1) pause heavy eval jobs, 2) scale manually to safe pool, 3) enable local-ssd fallback for warmup. I'm pausing evals now and notifying infra.

ops-runbook-bot: Action logged: manual-mitigation-step initiated by maya. Reminder: document temporary overrides.

aj: starting manual scale to 90 replicas: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-runtime -n prod --replicas=90`

sam: while that runs, I'll attempt a workaround - patch deployment to mount EFS with increased retry: `mountOptions: "retry=10,hard,tcp"` and add `AWS_EFS_MAX_RETRIES=12` to init container env.

maya: applied patch. pods are restarting and some are landing with Ready but many still failing init with a different error: `efs-utils: failed to resolve mount target - timed out`.

pagerduty-bot: PD#INC-9021 acknowledged by maya. Escalation policy: inference-surge.

cs-rep: CS tickets coming in: #CS-1207 and #CS-1210 reporting timeouts and 503s for gen endpoints. Customers on Dedicated reported degraded throughput.

aj: note impact and escalate to SRE lead if customer SLA at risk. Maya can you take traffic snapshot (per-customer qps) and note impacted customers?

maya: pulling metrics - two enterprise tenants saw spikes in retries and elevated error rate. Logging shows timeouts rather than errors. p95 latency peaked ~9.6s before interventions. No evidence of incorrect responses.

sam: nodes are still being created slowly - underlying cloud provisioner returning `AttachVolume: volume busy` occasionally. I'm spinning a handful of instances with local-disk temp mounts as fallback and forcing pods with `nodeSelector=local-warmup` to land on them.

leah: infra confirmed eval-job eval-2026-12 canceled. That immediately cut warmup traffic ~45%.

maya: manual scale completed -> 90 replicas. Ready pods ~68/90. Queue dropped from 22k -> 12.4k in ~8 minutes. p50 latency back to 1.1s.

aj: doing an image pin to last-known-good: `kubectl set image deploy/inference-runtime inference-runtime=redwood/inference-runtime:v3.1.9-stable -n prod` just in case recent image change affected init scripts.

sam: I also nuked 4 suspect nodes to force reprovision; cloud now handing off mounts to different AZ endpoints - I see improved mount success.

opps-runbook-bot: Reminder: revert temporary mountOptions and env overrides after incident.

pagerduty-bot: PD#INC-9021 status updated to Investigating -> Mitigated by maya, sam.

maya: drafting customer-facing note for CS. Impact window ~ 00:12 - 00:58 UTC. Will include workaround: temporary rate-limit to heavy eval jobs and recommendation to avoid scheduled warmups across multiple tenants.

aj: plan: maintain manual cap for 45 minutes, monitor EFS burst metrics, then revert to HPA once stability confirmed. open follow-up ticket to add EFS throttling detection to alerting.

sam: filed infra ticket INFRA-1189 to investigate EFS mount target scaling and to add cross-AZ mount targets for warmup traffic.

oncall-scheduler: handoff note - aj will monitor for 2h; next oncall sam in 90 minutes. Escalate to rotation if page re-fires.

maya: tagging for postmortem: severity S2; suspected root cause = EFS burst limit + warmup traffic flood + insufficient pod warmup strategy.

cs-rep: notified impacted customers and queued follow-ups.

aj: closing actions for now - reverting only after 30m stable. Saving incident notes to PD and will link postmortem. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)
